sections.heading: What is Financial Planning?
sections.text: Financial planning is the process of managing your money to achieve life goals.

sections.heading: Why Goals Matter
sections.text: Goals give direction, improve discipline, and help track progress.

sections.heading: Types of Goals
sections.text:
Short-term (0–1 year)
Medium-term (1–5 years)
Long-term (5+ years)

sections.heading: Steps to Plan
sections.text:
1. Identify goals
2. Analyze finances
3. Budget
4. Save and invest
5. Review regularly

sections.heading: Prioritization
sections.text: Focus first on needs, emergency fund, and debt before lifestyle goals.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes
sections.text:
- Unrealistic goals
- Ignoring inflation
- Not reviewing plans
